book.name: 2 PEETA
book.title: Di Sekant Leta Weh PEETA Rait

content: Di faals teecha dehn

Jos laik how dehn mi ga dehn faals prafit eena Izrel, da sayhn way soh, yu wahn ga dehn faals teecha weh wahn deh monks unu. Dehn wahn kohn pahn di slai wid sohn teechin weh da noh chroo ahn weh wahn mek peepl kom anda jojment; ahn dehn wahn ton dehn bak pahn Krais, di Wan weh set dehn free fahn di powa a sin, ahn soh dehn wahn bring kwik dischrokshan pahn dehnself.
Lata peepl wahn fala dehn bikaaz dehn waahn liv loos laif. Ahn weh dehn di du wahn mek peepl taak bad tingz gens di chroo way weh wee fala.
Sayka weh dehn soh greedi, dehn sweet mowt wan wahn tel unu stoari weh dehn mek op. Bot fi dehn jojment di heng rait oava dehn hed kaa Gaad noh di sleep.
Gaad neva spayr eevn di aynjel dehn wen dehn mi sin. Ih chayn dehn op ahn chroa dehn eena di daak pit a hel til Jojment Day.

Sayhn way soh, Gaad neva spayr di oal werl wen ih mek di flod kohn pahn dehn peepl weh neva obay Gaad. Di oanli wan weh ih sayv da-mi Noawa, weh mi-di preech tu dehn dat dehn fi liv rait eena Gaad sait. Ih sayv hihn ahn sebm ada peepl.
Gaad mi kandem di siti dehn a Sadam ahn Gomora;
ih mi bon dehn op wid faiya, ahn ih mi mek dehn bee wahn egzampl a weh wahn hapm tu dehn peepl weh noh obay ahn.
Bot Gaad mi sayv Lat
bikaaz hihn da-mi wahn man weh waak rait wid Gaad, ahn weh kudn stan si di way how di peepl dehn mi soh wikid ahn how dehn mi-di liv bad.
Lat mi liv rait deh monks dehn bot ih kudn tek how dehn liv wikid, ahn evri day ih hat ih haat fi si it.
Soh yu si, di Laad noa how fi sayv fi hihn peepl fahn di chroblz ahn chraiyalz weh dehn di goh chroo, ahn ih ponish di wan dehn weh eevl wail dehn di wayt fi Jojment Day.

Moa dan aal, Gaad wahn lik dehn wan weh liv loos laif, weh di fala dehn haat fi du doti tingz wid dehn badi; ahn Gaad wahn lik dehn wan weh rifyooz fi obay ahn. Dehn faals teecha, dehn noh frayd fi nobadi ahn dehn ful a dehnself. Dehn noh eevn frayd fi slanda dehn beengz weh geh dehn gloari fahn hevn.
Di aynjel dehn lat moa schranga ahn ga moa powa dan dehndeh faals teecha, bot eevn dehn neva akyooz dehn beengz a gloari ner dehn neva slanda dehn fronta di Laad.

Bot dehn teecha deh, dehn taak bad bowt dehn tingz weh dehn noh noa notn bowt. Dehn da jos laik wail animal weh noh tink ataal. Dehn jos du weh dehn hed gi dehn fi du. Soh jos laik how di wail animal dehn baan ahn kom eena di werl fi mek peepl kech dehn ahn kil dehn, sayhn way soh, Gaad wahn dischrai dehn wikid peepl.

Sayka weh dehn mi mek peepl sofa, dehn wahn sofa tu ahn geh pay bak fi weh dehn du. Eevn eena di day taim, dehn laik fi ga wail paati, ahn du eniting dehn feel laik wid dehn badi. Dehn da wahn shaym ahn disgrays wen dehn kohn tugeda wid yu fi eet, ahn sayhn taim, dehn hapi bikaaz a di way dehn di fool unu.

Aal dehn di luk fa da fi wahn chaans fi sleep rong ahn soh cheet op pahn dehn hozban er dehn waif. Da laik dehn kyaahn geh inof a sin. Dehn chrap dehn peepl weh week. Dehn haat ful a loan greedinis. Dehn deh anda di jojment a Gaad.
Dehn don lef di way weh rait ahn soh laas dehn way. Dehn fala di way a Baylam, weh da Bayor son, weh oanli lov di moni weh ih geh fi du rang.
Da Baylam dongki weh mi stap ahn fahn du ih eevl werk wen di dongki skoal ahn eena wahn man vais.

Dehn wikid peepl deh da sayhn laik wahn wel weh noh ga no waata eena it. Dehn da laik wahn daak klowd weh di shoa dat rayn wahn kohn, bot di schrang breez bloa ahn weh, ahn soh no rayn noh kohn ataal. Gaad di kip wahn daak daak plays fi put dehn kaina peepl.
Dehn boas bowt dehnself wid werdz weh no meen notn. Dehn yooz dehn doti kaina laif fi chrap dehn wan weh jos mi-di chrai get weh fahn liv da kaina laif deh.
Dehn pramis freedom tu evribadi bot dehn dehnself da-mi slayv tu fi dehn sin ahn koropshan; bikaaz yu si, yu da wahn slayv tu eniting weh kanchroal yu.

If peepl kohn fi noa bowt wi Laad ahn Sayvya Jeezas Krais, ahn eskayp fahn dehn eevl way weh di dischrai peepl eena di werl, ahn den ton bak ahn goh tu da kaina bad laif agen, den dehn laif wahn wos dan how ih mi yoostu bee.
Ih wuda mi beta if dehn mi neva noa di rait way fi liv ataal, dan fi noa it ahn den ton dehn bak pan it, ahn pahn di komanment dehn weh hoali.
Weh hapm tu dehn proov seh di praverb dehn da chroo weh seh, “Wahn daag wahn goh bak tu ih oan vamit ahn lik it op.” Ahn, “Wahn pig weh yu wash wahn goh bak ahn roal rong eena di mod agen.”

footnotes.text: Sadam ahn Gomora da-mi too tong weh Gaad mi dischrai sayka weh dehn mi soh wikid (Jenisiz 19:24).
